definitions.gloss: steep slope; steep hill; steep incline
definitions.explanation: A road or path with a sharp incline or decline. Used for slopes that are notably steep and difficult to climb or descend.

examples.japanese: {急坂|きゅうざか}を{登|のぼ}る。
この{急坂|きゅうざか}は{自転車|じてんしゃ}では{無理|むり}だ。
examples.english: This steep slope is impossible by bicycle.

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}から{家|いえ}まで{急坂|きゅうざか}が{続|つづ}くので、{毎日|まいにち}の{通勤|つうきん}がいい{運動|うんどう}になっている。
examples.english: Since there are steep hills all the way from the station to my house, my daily commute serves as good exercise.

notes:
Composed of {急|きゅう} (steep/sudden) + {坂|さか} (slope/hill). Can also be read as きゅうはん in more formal or technical contexts, though きゅうざか is the standard reading.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {急坂|きゅうざか}を{登|のぼ}る: to climb a steep hill
- {急坂|きゅうざか}を{下|くだ}る: to go down a steep hill
- {急坂|きゅうざか}が{続|つづ}く: steep hills continue
- {急坂|きゅうざか}{注意|ちゅうい}: caution: steep slope (road sign)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {坂道|さかみち}: sloping road — any road on a slope, not necessarily steep
- {上|のぼ}り{坂|ざか}: uphill slope — going up, any gradient
- {下|くだ}り{坂|ざか}: downhill slope — going down, any gradient
- {勾配|こうばい}: gradient/grade — technical term for slope angle
